sections.heading: Severe Warning
list: Investments in crypto-assets and the yield obtained therefrom may experience significant changes in value, both upward and downward, and the entire amount invested may even be lost.
Investments made in projects that are in early stages of development always involve a high level of risk.
Cryptoassets are not covered by investor protection mechanisms such as deposit or guarantee funds.
The lack of liquidity of many cryptoassets can make it difficult or impossible for investors to unwind their investments.
Distributed ledger technologies are still in early maturity stages and may have flaws in operation and security.
The anonymity of cryptoassets makes them a target for cybercriminals, and lost credentials can lead to permanent loss.
Custody of cryptoassets carries the risk of total loss in the event of theft or loss of private keys.
Acceptance of cryptoassets as payment is still very limited and not legally mandatory.
Service providers outside the EU may complicate dispute resolution for investors.
